title: Innovating for Sustainable Agriculture in the Americas
reason: Discusses the importance of agriculture and the need for innovation in the Americas.

tasks.task: Highlight the significance of agriculture in the Americas.

subtasks.text: Note that agriculture is fundamental for development and food security.
Observe that agriculture provides livelihoods for over 100 million people.

tasks.task: Explain the challenges faced by agriculture and the need for change.

subtasks.text: Observe that agriculture, more than most activities, impacts climate change.
Note that climate change affects agriculture and producers.

tasks.task: Describe the vision for sustainable and inclusive agriculture.

subtasks.text: Observe the need for a production paradigm that increases yields and reduces climate change impact.
Highlight the need for increased innovation and political will.

tasks.task: Emphasize the role of the Inter-American Institute for promoting agriculture and innovation.

subtasks.text: Note that the Institute is the best partner for promoting agriculture and rural development in the Americas.
Observe that the Institute shares innovative results to help countries learn from each other.
